svg.title: Rishikesh Kallapally — backend and full-stack developer
svg.desc: Animated banner: name, Electronics and Instrumentation at NIT Silchar, class of 2027; a typing line cycling through Spring Boot APIs, full-stack React apps, LLM tools in Java, caching and measuring, and a tiny RTOS; and a neon-tinted portrait of Rishikesh inside a glowing ring, fed by circuit traces, with a speech bubble cycling through developer one-liners: it works on my machine; git commit final_v2_FINAL; talk is cheap, show me the code; sleep(0), placement season.
